strengths: Immediate audio-driven reaction hook in first seconds
High simplicity and ease of production
concerns: Crude bodily sound humor has poor tonal alignment with Royal Match aesthetic
Heavy reliance on audio effect and text overlay context
rejection_reasons: Lacks a natural bridge to match-3 puzzle gameplay or player intervention mechanics
Weak transferability to the Royal Match castle environment and King Robert dynamic
adaptation_idea: King Robert reacts with dismay as smelly green gas leaks into his throne room, prompting players to swipe tiles to clear the hazards before he passes out.
